## Telomir Announces Peer-Reviewed Publication Showing Telomir-Zn Restores Visual Function and Retinal Structure in a Model of Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)


MIAMI, Sept. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Telomir Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: TELO), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing small-molecule therapeutics targeting epigenetic and metabolic drivers of cancer, today announced the peer-reviewed publication of new preclinical research showing that Telomir-Zn significantly improved visual function, restored retinal structure, and reduced mitochondrial oxidative stress in a model of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). The findings…
